info.name: Quran App API
info.description:
Every endpoint of apps/backend (claude.md 11.3) with success, validation and error cases.

**Before running:** start the backend (`cd apps/backend && npm run start:dev`) against the database, wait until GET /health says `searchReady: true`.

**Variables:** `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:3001), `webOrigin` (must equal the backend WEB_ORIGIN), `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` (optional; set them in the environment — never commit real credentials), `allowAdminWrites` (default `false`; `true` lets folder 09 create / edit / delete and then revert everything — use the test database).

**Rate limits:** the run is sized to the default limits (100 requests/min overall, 30 searches, 10 exports, 5 logins). Folder 09 waits ~61 s for a fresh window when earlier folders already ran. Run the collection once per minute; the last folder deliberately triggers a 429.

Every response is also checked by the collection-level tests: response time, X-Request-Id, and the standard error body for 4xx/5xx.

pm.test('[all] has a safe X-Request-Id header', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).to.match(/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{8,128}$/));

item.name: 09 - Admin dashboard (Phase 6)
item.description:
Admin content API (claude.md 11.17). Needs adminEmail / adminPassword (logged-in requests are skipped otherwise).

**Writes are opt-in:** requests that change data only run with `allowAdminWrites=true`, and every change is reverted inside the folder (temporary topic deleted, sura name and book author restored). Use it against the isolated test database (`npm run db:test:create`), not production.

Reads, validation (400), not-found (404), conflicts (409) and unauthenticated (401) cases never write anything.
